author: MD0001
quote: The graphics are choppy and clunky during gunfights at 20FPS. The map is 50% swamp and mountains. The city is very small. You cant steal exensive cars because of trackers and have to buy 14€/month sub to drive one. The story forces you not to shoot people and do chores for your virtual girlfriend. For 1000€ PS5 you can visit Florida in real life in 8k  240 fps 8k, with more realistic NPCs than ever
